purpose: The registry of authored learning content. It is intentionally empty at this stage: the repository has indexed sources and a curriculum model, but no lesson has been written, so no lesson is claimed. Everything the platform displays about a lesson is meant to be derived from this file, including whether it is verified.

lesson_schema.title: string
covers_outcomes: the exact outcome strings from the competency that this lesson assesses
supplemental_references: reference ids from knowledge/references/external.json, or null
prerequisites: competency or lesson ids the learner must have completed
exercise_ids: EX-... ids, all defined in the exercises array
lesson_schema.content_path: relative path in the repository once written
lesson_schema.publication_state: one of the publication_state values in knowledge/states.json
lesson_schema.verification_record_id: null until a verification record exists
lesson_schema.provenance_note: states explicitly which claims come from the source, which are established theory, and which examples are originally authored

origin_detail.work_id: required when origin is source or adapted
origin_detail.section: source section the item comes from
origin_detail.source_item_id: the source's own numbering, preserved rather than renumbered

exercise_schema.difficulty: recognition | guided | independent | multi_step | transfer | open_ended
exercise_schema.solution_path: null until a solution exists; an exercise without one may not be marked verified
exercise_schema.solution_verified_by: verification method actually used (independent computation, execution, cross-check against a reference)
exercise_schema.rubric: required for open-ended items instead of a single solution

checks.name: source_fidelity | technical_correctness | mathematical_validity | pedagogical_completeness | prerequisite_integrity | assessment_integrity | citation_integrity | interactive_correctness | publication_integrity

unresolved_issues: each with an owner-action and a next step

current_state.note: No lesson has been written. Any interface built in the next phase must render this state honestly rather than presenting the curriculum model as if it were course content.
